technical_and_design_decisions: Adopt stdin/stdout process wrapper (or Jython script engine fallback) for Python processor integration to ensure portability and simple IPC within Spring XD stream execution.
Utilize Renjin (JVM-based R engine) or Rscript execution wrapper for R processor implementation to provide native streaming integration with Spring XD pipelines.
Implement the Hive Sink using Spring Hadoop / Spring Integration ORM/JDBC/HDFS abstraction for robust distributed data writing.
Implement a unified Spring Security RBAC and ACL evaluation engine shared between REST API endpoints, DSL Shell command security, and Admin UI controllers.
Upgrade Spring Core dependency to 4.1.1 across all project POMs/build scripts, leveraging compiled SpEL expressions where dynamic evaluation performance is critical.
assumptions: The target architecture is Spring XD 1.x stream processing framework built on Spring Framework.
Standard enterprise deployment environments (Java 17+/Java 8 depending on Spring Core baseline) are available for testing Python/R execution environments and Apache Hive.
A local or test Apache Hive server/cluster environment is available for integration testing the Hive sink.
Single software developer performing all analysis, design, implementation, testing, and documentation activities.

activities.activity_description: Investigate Python and R integration mechanisms (Jython/Renjin vs stdin/stdout IPC), design the ACL security framework for DSL Shell and Admin UI, and plan the upgrade path for Spring Core 4.1.1.

activities.activity_name: U1 - SSL/HTTPS & Basic Auth Admin Security Configuration
activities.activity_description: Implement configuration options and clear reference setup for enabling SSL/HTTPS and Basic authentication on administration endpoints.
Develop and test a generic Python processor component for Spring XD, handling data serialization, script execution, and output mapping.
Develop and test an R processor component for Spring XD leveraging Renjin/rJava/Rscript execution, handling data conversions in streaming pipelines.
Implement and test the Spring XD Hive sink module for writing streamed data into Apache Hive tables and distributed storage.

activities.activity_name: U5 - Spring Core 4.1.1 Upgrade & SpEL Validation
activities.activity_description: Upgrade project build dependencies to Spring Core 4.1.1, resolve build/compilation issues, and verify compiled SpEL performance benefits and compatibility.

activities.activity_name: U6 - Entity REST API Security Definitions
activities.activity_description: Configure Spring Security role/group access control definitions for REST API endpoints and business domain entities.

activities.activity_name: U7 & U8 - Resource ACLs for DSL Shell & Admin UI
activities.activity_description: Implement fine-grained ACL permissions (create/destroy/view stream access) for resources accessed via the DSL Shell and Admin UI web console.
Execute end-to-end regression testing across security, processors, and sinks, and write operational/configuration documentation for all user stories.
